title: Sage magazine floral editorial
reference_style: Powder-blue background, sage panel, oversized serif title and botanical illustration framing.

reverse_engineered_prompt.concept: Elegant spring fashion magazine cover with oversized serif typography and delicate botanical illustration.

subject.pose: Back turned three-quarters to camera, looking over shoulder
subject.wardrobe: Minimalist muted sage-green satin backless evening dress
subject.hair: Long auburn-brown hair, half-up styling with soft fringe
subject.accessories: Tiny flower hair clip and delicate earrings

composition.panel: Large muted teal rounded rectangle behind model, centered with generous margins
composition.florals: Blue-violet botanical line-art flowers entering from upper-left and lower-right corners
composition.subject_layer: Model overlaps panel and title to create depth

typography.headline: SAGE
typography.style: Very large high-contrast white Didone serif, with a delicate outlined duplicate offset over the filled letters
typography.placement: Across the central panel, partially obscured by model
typography.hierarchy: Headline dominates; keep all other copy minimal

post_processing.style: Clean magazine art direction with restrained botanical collage

reverse_engineered_prompt.negative_prompt: No awkward shoulder anatomy, extra arms, malformed fingers, messy typography, heavy shadows, watermark, logo.
